description: Fictitious sanitized engineering examples. Targets denote relevant questions, not independently verified fixes. Negative expectations distinguish permitted related results from unsupported applicability claims.

documents.title: Gradle cannot select org.example:client:2.1.0 for Java 25
documents.body: No matching variant of org.example:client:2.1.0 was found. The consumer requires Java 25 but the published variant targets Java 26.

answers.body: Use a publication compiled for Java 25 or change the consumer toolchain. Inspect outgoingVariants before selecting a compatible artifact.

documents.title: NoClassDefFoundError for com.example.codec.Parser
documents.body: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: com/example/codec/Parser occurs at application startup although compilation succeeded.

answers.body: Add the missing codec runtime dependency, rather than compileOnly; inspect runtimeClasspath.
Inspect runtimeClasspath for a transitive exclusion of the codec dependency. Remove the exclusion and check that the packaged application contains the codec classes.

documents.title: Database connection pool exhausted after requests
documents.body: Requests eventually wait forever for a database connection. Borrowed JDBC connections are never returned after exceptions.

answers.body: Use try-with-resources or Kotlin use to close borrowed connections on every path. Measure active connections after failures.

documents.title: Duplicate payment rows when clients retry after a timeout
documents.body: A payment succeeds on the server but the client loses the response. Retrying creates a second payment.

answers.body: Reserve a stable idempotency key with a unique database constraint in the same transaction as the payment.

documents.title: Browser write fails with Invalid CSRF token
documents.body: Session-authenticated POST requests return 403 Invalid CSRF token while GET requests work.

answers.body: Fetch the masked CSRF token and send X-CSRF-TOKEN with the session cookie.

documents.title: JWT issuer mismatch inside Docker
documents.body: OIDC JWT validation fails with issuer mismatch when a service uses localhost inside a container.

answers.body: Use one advertised issuer reachable by the browser and backend. localhost inside a container addresses that container.

documents.title: PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 40P01 during opposite row updates
documents.body: Concurrent transactions update parent and child rows in opposite order and PostgreSQL detects a deadlock.

answers.body: Acquire parent locks in one consistent order across mutations; retry the entire aborted transaction.

documents.title: Angular NG0100 after changing state during view checking
documents.body: ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError NG0100 appears after modifying component state in a checked lifecycle hook.

answers.body: Move initialization before the checked view phase and avoid changing bound values during checking.

documents.title: Repeated rows across pages with equal creation times
documents.body: Sorting only by createdAt produces missing or repeated results when timestamps tie.

answers.body: Use a stable compound keyset cursor with createdAt and UUID as a unique tie breaker.

documents.title: Stale search index reveals moderated answers
documents.body: Search results expose answer excerpts after a moderator hides the answer; background cleanup has not finished.

answers.body: Join search candidates against current product visibility and revision before constructing excerpts.

documents.title: Gradle org.example:client:1.9.0 missing artifact
documents.body: Could not find org.example:client:1.9.0 in the repository. This release has never been published.

answers.body: Correct the coordinate or publish that artifact. A toolchain change does not fix a missing artifact.

documents.title: C++ linker undefined reference in native parser
documents.body: C++ parser fails during native linking because the object file is omitted from target sources.

answers.body: Add the native object to the link target.

documents.title: C# nullable reference warning in parser
documents.body: C# parser reports CS8602 possible null reference dereference.

documents.title: PostgreSQL 18 versus PostgreSQL 15 upgrade plan
documents.body: The test environment runs PostgreSQL 18; another project remains on PostgreSQL 15. No upgrade compatibility evidence is provided.

answers.body: Evaluate extensions and upgrade requirements separately for each major version.
